resources.string: Count your Steam history toward XP?
This optional, one-time import counts pre-existing Steam lifetime playtime toward XP using your existing rules. New playtime continues to be tracked separately.
Steam lifetime totals have no session dates. Importing them cannot recreate past sessions, daily quests, or streaks.
Library sync must confirm a readable library for this account before history can be imported. You can review setup or skip this for now.
Your historical minutes are saved. Updating XP is still pending; recovery will use those saved minutes, without importing them again.
Your requested import is in progress. You can continue while it finishes.
Steam history is already imported for this account. No second import is needed.
You can import or recover history later in Settings → Data & privacy.
